title: Convex internal shape serialization
summary: Recovers the thiscall base serialization routine at 0x438870: serializer name lookup, unique-pointer translation, conditional name serialization, ordered raw-word field copies and type-name return. Preserves untouched words at +8 and +0x30.
test_description: 96 differential calls against original thiscall reference cover null/non-null names, zero/high-bit unique pointers, callback order and arguments, callback mutations, in-place destination, raw float/NaN payloads, full source/destination byte comparison, untouched words and original type-name address. Controlled serializer callbacks exercise only the target's dispatch contract.
known_limits: Serializer internals and derived serializers are outside scope; slot names follow the evidenced Bullet serialization contract.
The portable return uses identical type-name text, not the original executable address.
Null object, destination or serializer and throwing callbacks are outside the valid tested contract.
Partial overlapping objects other than exact in-place serialization are not modeled as valid C++ objects.
No matching-byte claim or full-game integration validation.
